headline: Arsenal 'not actively seeking' Myles Lewis-Skelly, Ethan Nwaneri exits but will consider 'right opportunity'
description: Arsenal would consider exits for Myles Lewis-Skelly and Ethan Nwaneri if "the right opportunity" came up but are not actively seeking their departure, CEO Richard Garlick told BBC Sport.

headline: Man United in talks with Brighton for Carlos Baleba - sources
description: Manchester United are in talks with Brighton over a deal for Carlos Baleba, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Do Man United need to sign more midfielders in transfer window?
description: Man United coach Michael Carrick has espoused the importance of a strong midfield -- but without more transfers, United may fall behind.

headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

headline: Aston Villa complete signing of Matteo Ruggeri from Atlético Madrid
description: Aston Villa have completed the signings of left-back Matteo Ruggeri from Atlético Madrid and goalkeeper Zion Suzuki from Parma.

headline: Jack Grealish and Everton 'remained in contact' - club chief
description: Jack Grealish has stayed in contact with Everton after last season's loan move was cut short by injury, the club's CEO said.
